newsitem.title: USA: General Growth unit to manage Texas mall.
newsitem.headline: General Growth unit to manage Texas mall.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Friday its property management subsidiary had won a contract to manage the San Jacinto Mall in Baytown, Texas, for Aetna Life Insurance Co.
General Growth Management Inc, the subsidiary, assumed management and leasing responsibilities on October 1.
The value of the contract was not disclosed.
General Growth currently has ownership interests in, or management responsibilities for, 112 shopping malls in 35 states.
